title: Ubiquitous germination among common perennial species in response to facilitated and unfacilitated microhabitats
why: Light and nitrogen treatments explicitly include Sphaeralcea ambigua among four experimental species. The abstract reports differing light-level responses across beneficiaries but no S. ambigua-specific light or nitrogen outcome. Full text is needed to determine its nonvisual light response and whether nitrogen effects establish a chemical-cue response.
